title: Forge Omega V2 Dashboard — Phase 1-3 UX/UI delivery (was awaiting Codex acceptance since 2026-05-18)

background.stack: Next.js 16.2.6 + React 19 + TypeScript 5 + Tailwind CSS 4 (0 TypeScript errors)
background.components_ready: 10+ components already built — visual/UX improvements needed, not full rewrites
background.blocker_prior: TASK marked 'Awaiting Codex acceptance' but Codex never picked it up — now manually queued
background.windows_only_note: Run from Windows PowerShell only (Turbopack WSL bug). Builds + screenshots happen Windows-side. Code edits can happen from WSL.

deliverables: Fleet Health Summary Card — 7/8 agents healthy with visual bar; green/yellow/red by health %; live indicator (connected/reconnecting/offline)
Status Badges (consistent) — color + icon + text (never color-only); WCAG AA contrast
Visual Hierarchy — primary metrics 2-3x larger than secondary; consistent spacing scale (Tailwind 4 with design tokens)
Live indicator — exact 3 states: connected (green dot pulse), reconnecting (yellow spin), offline (red)
acceptance: Storybook (if exists) or app pages render the new card

deliverables: Loading skeletons — every fetch shows skeleton placeholder, not spinner
Optimistic UI — actions render immediately, rollback on error
Error messages — explain WHAT happened + WHY + WHEN resolves + WHAT to do (e.g., 'Quota exhausted. Resets in 18h 42m. [Retry?]')
Toast notifications — bottom-right, auto-dismiss 4-6s, success/error/warning variants
acceptance: Each component documented inline with usage example
Toast container is global and accessible (aria-live polite/assertive)

deliverables: Confirmation dialogs for destructive actions — Cancel is default focus; consequence in 1-2 sentences
Form validation — progressive (on blur), inline errors with red text + help text
Keyboard navigation — full tab order, focus rings visible, escape closes modals
acceptance: All forms validate on blur (not submit-only)
Lighthouse Accessibility ≥ 95 on the dashboard page

global_acceptance: Phase commits separately with descriptive messages — push only after พี่ review
Report progress at each phase completion
Run on Windows: cd D:\Git\forge-omega-v2 && npm run dev (port 3000)
constraints: Code edits happen from WSL; builds + screenshots from Windows PowerShell only
Do not run foreground PowerShell from WSL — write a no-window launcher and surface to พี่
Do not commit secrets (.env.local stays out of git)
Stop and report after each phase if any acceptance criterion fails
